text:
The previous SQL already includes customer_name; keep it.

SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(oi.product_price) AS beverage_revenue FROM jaffle_shop.dev.order_items AS oi JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE LOWER(p.product_type) LIKE '%beverage%' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY beverage_revenue DESC LIMIT 10
